validated_objective: Release QIF v0.6.41 with an executable, auditable, domain-general judge consequence and abstention robustness lifecycle.
scope: reviewed judge-condition variants for downstream use, consequence framing, and abstain availability
identical-evidence trial groups with explicit expected labels and output taxonomy
deterministic sensitivity and abstention robustness assessment with governance
schema, verifier, example, retained fixtures, plain-language docs, roadmap, AOF evidence, tag, and GitHub release
constraints: No hidden chain-of-thought collection, judge optimization or ranking, automatic judge replacement, authorization, or policy/rubric mutation
No conversion of accuracy, abstention, refusal, malformed-output, or sensitivity counts into quality, truth, competence, optimality, or authority
No employee surveillance or blame assignment
expected_outcomes: Humans and AI can reproduce whether identical evidence receives stable and correctly typed outcomes under controlled consequence and abstention conditions.
Consequence-sensitive, insufficient, unverified, or unjustifiably abstaining behavior becomes explicit governance work before judge reliance.
